name: URM ~M15 Wakusei ni Umarete~
source:
A group of people born on the planet M15 set off to a space voyage in search of truth behind exodus from the Earth.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-january-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
